fabrication.structural_frame: supplier-cut stock and bolted catalog connectors
fabrication.custom_structural_adapters: flat cut/drilled plates compatible with home assembly

functions.keyboard_mouse_surface: independently adjustable with vertical movement and rotation; stable during typing
functions.cables: continuous routed paths, joint slack, strain relief and household power connection

not_inherited_from_r6: hardcoded part counts and nominal interface allowances
cad_method: design intent, parametric sketches and mechanism layout first; original part design and make-or-buy decisions; shared interfaces, explicit assembly mates and documented physical assembly order
catalog_geometry_rule: Manufacturer data is required to represent a specific purchased component accurately. It is not a prerequisite for starting CAD or designing original parts.

motion_validation.scope: Each coordinate across its full range with other coordinates at Working; also coordinated preset positions. Blocked samples retained. No continuous path certificate.

architecture: One closed shared spine, three independent face-mounted carriages, closed tube links, bolted flat end fittings, purchased bearing/shaft and manual height-lock interfaces
